title: study lab.yaml v2
description: Declarative spec of a break/fix lab. v2 is a strict superset of v1: every v1 file (no schema_version) validates unchanged, and the runner fills the v2 fields it can infer. Behaviour is added with metadata here, never with new runner code. Keys starting with x- are free for extensions.

schema_version.description: Absent means v1 (legacy). New labs write 2.

title.description: Topic title from the syllabus (can be as short as a subcommand, e.g. KCA 3.3 "jp").

provider.description: v1 field. local = runs on the student's machine in a container.

resources.description: v1 field, kept for compatibility. The runner reads limits instead when present.

setup.description: v1 field: scripts the lab ships. The first one is the break/fix script unless 'script' says otherwise.

requires.description: Environment family. Picks the runner image: kind/k3s -> study-lab:k8s, linux -> study-lab:linux. Inferred for v1 labs (kubectl in the script -> kind).

kubernetes.description: Kubernetes minor or patch for kind/k3s labs (e.g. '1.35' or '1.35.8'). Default: the image's pinned node.

nodes.description: kind topology: number of worker nodes besides the control plane.

script.description: Path of the break/fix script, relative to the lab directory.

run_in.description: Where the script runs. runner = the lab container (kubectl against kind); node = inside the kind control-plane node (kubelet, static pods, /etc/kubernetes).

run_as.description: User that runs the script inside the container.

modes.description: How the three contract actions map onto the script. Lets an existing script with different verbs (check, clean, --restore...) join the contract with metadata only.

env.description: Environment for every mode (e.g. the confirmation variables the scripts read).

ports.description: Ports published from the lab container to 127.0.0.1 on the host.

hints.description: Progressive hints, shown one at a time by 'study-lab hint'.

generated_by.description: model that wrote it, for generated labs

verified.description: Proof that break makes verify fail and the fix makes it pass, in the runner.

license.description: SPDX id, e.g. Apache-2.0 (this repo) or MIT.

stdin.description: Text piped to the script (answers to confirmation prompts).

success.description: When the lab counts as solved. Default: exit code 0. output_regex is for scripts whose verify always exits 0.
